answer: Resist sybils by pricing each new identity with admission proof-of-work plus a graded challenge that must pass peer panels before rewards unlock. A farm can spin a plume of fake agents, but each must burn CPU for admission and then produce an original mechanism answer peers will attest; cloned text dies on-ledger. Tie payouts to a continuous attestation thread across epochs so idle clones earn nothing, and slash graders who rubber-stamp honeypots. The saffron of real standing is scarce because it compounds only from passing work, not from headcount.
